name: Tenant
description: Tenant — the top-level multi-tenancy boundary. One row per tenant with display name, owner, branding (logo), root folder, and billing flags. All tenant-scoped data references this via tenantId.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Plan-55 — uniform tenant numbering. Bootstrap admin tenant gets id=0 on fresh-schema first insert (sequence STARTS WITH 0). User-registered tenants in MA-MT (or SA-MT) get auto-generated ids 1, 2, 3, ... PostgreSQL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY accepts explicit ids, so deploy paths can write id=0 explicitly if needed; user-registration paths leave id absent and let the sequence assign.

attributes.name: folderId
attributes.description: Tenant related folder where tenant's documents are stored
